args.summary: Commit 45b232b added the `discount_code` column to the SQLAlchemy `Order` model and related routers, but no database migration was created or applied to add the `discount_code` column to the `orders` table in PostgreSQL. This causes a `ProgrammingError` (UndefinedColumn) on all `/checkout`, `/orders`, and `/orders/{id}` requests starting from the deploy at 14:06 UTC.

report.summary: Commit 45b232b added the `discount_code` column to the SQLAlchemy `Order` model and related routers, but no database migration was created or applied to add the `discount_code` column to the `orders` table in PostgreSQL. This causes a `ProgrammingError` (UndefinedColumn) on all `/checkout`, `/orders`, and `/orders/{id}` requests starting from the deploy at 14:06 UTC.

truth.key_detail: column orders.discount_code is used by the code since commit 45b232b but was never added to the database
red_herrings: README-only commit about ten minutes before the incident, never deployed
payment retry WARNINGs that also occur in the healthy period
truth.expected_fix: add and run a migration that adds a nullable orders.discount_code column (or roll the api back to the previous commit)
truth.notes: Both POST /checkout and GET /orders fail because the ORM selects the new column on every read of orders. The worker was not redeployed and keeps working.
